sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER
They are heard.
Perused the case diary / challan papers.

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.13/2023 registered at Police Station Crime Branch, District- Indore (MP)
for offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 120-B of Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text: Police Station Crime Branch, District- Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 21.03.2023.
The allegation against the applicant, according to the FIR is of obtaining a sum of Rs.24 lakhs from the complainant Dharampal Singh, a resident of Sirsa, Haryana.
It is alleged that the applicant obtained the aforesaid amount from the complainant in the name of investment and did not return the same.

Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case as he is a resident of Bhopal and is maintaining a bank account in HDFC Bank, Indore where the Bhuvneshwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87812658/
1 amount has been deposited by the complainant and the amount is also of Rs.14 lakhs only and not of Rs.24 lakhs as alleged by the complainant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that the amount was obtained by the applicant towards advisory services as he is a qualified Investment Advisor and has a certificate issued by National Institute of Securities Market.
Thus, it is submitted that the applicant be released on bail as he is lodged in jail since 21.03.2023 and the final conclusion of trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
It is also submitted that the applicant is ready to deposit such amount as this Court deems fit to direct.

Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer, however, it is not denied that as per the case-diary, the amount which has been credited to the account of the present applicant is around 14 lakhs and it is further submitted that the investigation is still pending and the charge-sheet has not been filed.

On due consideration of submissions and on perusal of the case diary, it is found that the applicant has received the amount may be towards his service charges or for investment, however, there is nothing on record to suggest that the amount has been defalcated by the applicant and in such circumstances, considering the fact that the applicant is also ready to deposit certain amount, this Court deems it appropriate to allow the present application, subject to the applicant depositing a sum of Rs.7.5 lakhs in the Trial Court.

Accordingly, without reflecting anything on the merits of the case, the application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant is hereby allowed, subject to deposit of total sum of Rs.7,50,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakhs Fifty Thousand) by the applicant or any other person on his behalf, out of which, Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand) upfront before his release i.e.
at the time of furnishing the bail bond in a fixed deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court and rest of Rs.6,00,000/-(Rupees Six Lakhs) to be deposited by the applicant in six equal installments of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh) each within a period of six months from the date of his release in a fix deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court and the said amount shall be subject to the final outcome of the case by the trial Court.

The deposit receipt/certificate so produced by the applicant shall be endorsed by the learned Judge of the lower Court to be, 'furnished towards the bail of the applicants and shall be subject to the final decision of the case by the trial Court'.

It is further directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, to appear before the trial Court on the dates given by the Court.
This bail order shall be subject to furnishing an undertaking that the applicant will deposit the amount respectively as directed above.

It is also directed that the applicants will abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
C.c. as per rules.
